input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant runs to "Client" only: neither Affiliates nor contractors acting on our behalf are licensed, and the only expansion mechanic (amending Exhibit "A" sites on written notice under 2(b)(ii)) covers locations, not additional entities — so there is no path to add Affiliates, which fails the fallback ("Affiliates covered on written notice"). Transfer is also blocked: § 15 requires the other party's consent except for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate, so a successor in an M&A transaction is not covered, again short of the fallback. Redline extends the grant to Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (with Client responsible for their compliance) and adds a mutual successor-transfer carve-out. Positively, the licence is not revocable at TrueLink's discretion (term runs until termination under § 2(c)/§ 13-14), so this is not walk-away territory; we note but do not flag that § 13's automatic cut-off of Sections 2 and 3 for breach of Sections 8a-8c has no cure period, and that the licence is not perpetual/paid-up.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client's Affiliates and contractors and allow transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (with us remaining responsible for their compliance), since our group and outsourced processors need to use the Interface in the ordinary course of the licensed business. We have also confirmed that either party may transfer to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets; if you prefer, we can instead add Affiliates on written notice to TrueLink.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Client's behalf a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement. For purposes of this Agreement, "Affiliate" means any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Client, and Client shall remain responsible for its Affiliates' and contractors' compliance with this Agreement.

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest in connection with a merger, reorganization, or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets or equity.
